comment: The enabling conditions are stated as capabilities to be built. Where foundational components already exist, the binding condition is not a further capability but the authority to require its use. Without that, the guidance offers no path from partial to comprehensive coverage other than continued persuasion.

public.text: The enabling conditions are stated as capabilities to be built. Where foundational components already exist, the binding condition is not a further capability but the authority to require its use. Without that, the guidance offers no path from partial to comprehensive coverage other than continued persuasion.
public.suggestedRevision: Add authority to the enabling conditions alongside capability and capacity: an identifiable party empowered to require participation, an enforceable norm, a durable funding basis and a dispute route. Present these as conditions of the same standing as the technical ones, since a country can satisfy every technical condition and remain unable to progress - which is the Dutch position after two decades of investment.
